facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports the Dar-es-Salaam to Mombasa terrestrial fibre link was officially launched on 21 July 2025 at the Lunga Lunga/Horohoro border, a joint effort of Kenya's ICT Authority and TTCL, connecting Kenya's NICTBB to Tanzania's national fibre network.
